subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent context/workspace on model fallback

question: Should OpenClaw model fallback switch to another agent/workspace, apply a model-specific context profile, or stay model-only with narrower fallback notice/re-injection behavior?
rationale: The missing behavior is visible in source, but the permanent public API affects config schema, session identity, agentDir/workspace ownership, auth routing, skills snapshots, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Define fallback context profiles
options.body: Add a first-class model or fallback context profile that controls bootstrap budget/files, skills visibility, and session-safe context without changing agent identity by default.

options.title: Add fallback agent/workspace switching
options.body: Allow fallback attempts to select another configured agent or workspace, but require explicit session, auth, state, and migration semantics before implementation.

options.title: Defer to narrower threads
options.body: Keep fallback model selection unchanged for now and solve only notification, re-injection, model-key, or auth-propagation subproblems in their own issues.

recommendation.title: Define fallback context profiles
recommendation.body: Add a first-class model or fallback context profile that controls bootstrap budget/files, skills visibility, and session-safe context without changing agent identity by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the design-oriented keep-open review and has the strongest local history on the fallback/config surface.
